parents.subject: Engineering Technology and Management for Agricultural Systems

ns2:course.label: Independent Study
ns2:course.description: Individual investigations or studies of any phases of technical systems management selected by the student and approved by the advisor and the faculty member who will supervise the study. 1 to 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated if topics vary up to 4 hours in the same term to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
